shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Task detail sheets and mobile navigation only.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover, selection, and disclosure state changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single strongest action in a local context.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: oklch(58% 0.19 255); color: oklch(99.5% 0.003 255); padding: 10px 14px; font: 600 14px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(51% 0.19 255); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(99.5% 0.003 255); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px oklch(58% 0.19 255 / .35); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Compact field with an explicit focus state.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid oklch(89% 0.012 255); border-radius: 10px; background: oklch(99.5% 0.003 255); color: oklch(20% 0.025 260); padding: 10px 12px; font: 400 14px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: oklch(78% 0.02 255); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(58% 0.19 255); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(58% 0.19 255 / .16); }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: A compact route row with a quiet selected state.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: block; border-radius: 8px; color: oklch(50% 0.025 260); padding: 9px 10px; font: 600 14px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: oklch(95.5% 0.01 255); color: oklch(20% 0.025 260); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(58% 0.19 255); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Text-backed operational state that never relies on color alone.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 6px; background: oklch(94% 0.035 255); color: oklch(45% 0.16 255); padding: 4px 7px; font: 600 12px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: A compact operating surface for teams already in motion. Disciplined hierarchy, restrained color, and flat structural layers keep projects and tasks visually dominant.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue is reserved for primary action, current navigation, focus, and selection.

dos: Do pair every status color with text or an icon.
Do show recovery guidance for offline, unauthorized, empty, and failed states.
donts: Don't use playful multicolor task-board styling.
Don't use decorative glass effects, oversized rounded cards, or generic dashboard grids.
